business_summary: Orthofix Medical Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a medical technology company in the United States, Italy, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Brazil, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Global Spine and Global Limb Reconstruction. The Global Spine segment manufactures, distributes, and provides support services for bone growth stimulation devices that enhance bone fusion; designs, develops, and markets a portfolio of spine fixation implant products for use throughout the spinal column; and offers bone graft substitutes, such as fiber-based and particulate demineralized bone matrices, cellular bone allografts, collagen ceramic matrices, and synthetic bone void fillers in various forms with supporting graft delivery solutions to treat various spinal, orthopedic, and dental conditions. This segment also designs, develops, and markets a portfolio of navigation technologies, including tracked surgical tools, intelligent software, and imaging equipment based on machine-vision and optical innovations; and 7D FLASH Navigation System, a navigation platform for spinal and cranial procedures. The Global Limb Reconstruction segment offers products and solutions for the underserved limb reconstruction market, including deformity correction, limb lengthening, complex fracture management, and limb preservation. This segment also designs, develops, and markets external and internal fixation limb reconstruction products that are coupled with enabling digital technologies to support the entire patient care continuum. It sells its products through distributors and sales representatives to hospitals, healthcare organizations, healthcare providers, ambulatory surgery centers, and out-patient hospitals. The company was formerly known as Orthofix International N.V. and changed its name to Orthofix Medical Inc. in July 2018. Orthofix Medical Inc. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Lewisville, Texas.
business_summary_ko: Orthofix Medical Inc.는 자회사와 함께 미국, 이탈리아, 영국, 프랑스, ​​독일, 브라질 및 국제적으로 의료 기술 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 이는 글로벌 척추(Global Spine)와 글로벌 사지 재건(Global Limb Reconstruction)이라는 두 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 글로벌 척추 부문은 뼈 융합을 강화하는 뼈 성장 자극 장치에 대한 지원 서비스를 제조, 유통 및 제공합니다. 척추 전체에 사용할 수 있는 척추 고정 임플란트 제품 포트폴리오를 설계, 개발 및 판매합니다. 다양한 척추, 정형외과 및 치과 질환을 치료하기 위한 이식 전달 솔루션을 지원하는 다양한 형태의 섬유 기반 및 미립자 탈회골 매트릭스, 세포성 뼈 동종이식, 콜라겐 세라믹 매트릭스 및 합성 골 공극 충전재와 같은 뼈 이식 대체물을 제공합니다. 이 부문은 또한 추적 수술 도구, 지능형 소프트웨어, 머신 비전 및 광학 혁신을 기반으로 한 이미징 장비를 포함한 내비게이션 기술 포트폴리오를 설계, 개발 및 판매합니다. 척추 및 두개골 시술을 위한 네비게이션 플랫폼인 7D FLASH Navigation System이 있습니다. Global Limb Reconstruction 부문은 제품과 솔루션을 제공합니다.
